{"metadata":{"description":"提供 Grok-compatible 网页搜索、保留来源分页、Context7 与 Exa 文档检索、有界网页提取、站点映射、子代理研究","id":"gh:1334476908","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-search-enhance","slug":"umineko987/dsh-search-enhance","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","search-enhancement"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"提供 Grok-compatible 网页搜索、保留来源分页、Context7 与 Exa 文档检索、有界网页提取、站点映射、子代理研究"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Search Enhance for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"`dsh-search-enhance` is a search extension for DeepSeek Harness. It uses a Grok-compatible Search AP"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"I for primary web answers and can optionally use Context7, Exa, Tavily, Firecrawl, Parallel, and Dee"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"pSeek for documentation lookup, supplementary discovery, page extraction, and site mapping."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The plugin presents search results, sources, and page content separately. Searches return an answer "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"or documentation snippets with source links; you can ask for more sources when needed. To check impo"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"rtant details, ask it to read the original page. Search snippets remain distinct from fetched page c"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"etails, ask it to read the original page. Search snippets remain distinct from fetched page content."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> Bring your own service addresses and keys; none are included. Ordinary web search needs a Grok-com"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"patible service. Other services are optional."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Key characteristics"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- `web_search` uses the Grok-compatible endpoint for the main answer and runs all user-selected supp"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"lemental Providers (Exa, Tavily, Firecrawl, Parallel, DeepSeek) in parallel, with an independent per"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"-Provider source limit.
- Sources are normalized, de-duplicated, and reordered using source category"},{"id":"p8s4","text":", requested version, and publication-time signals before they are shown.
- `web_research` uses a sep"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"arate research Agent for comparisons and source checks, keeping the current model. It returns conclu"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"sions, links, excerpts, and limitations, not the full investigation history.
- In DSH Web, open rese"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"arch records from the original conversation's subagent entry. With history saving enabled, completed"},{"id":"p8s8","text":", cancelled, and failed research remains readable after restart. Records are read-only, without word"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"-by-word updates, a running indicator, or continuation.
- `source_ref` stores complete source record"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"s separately, allowing pagination beyond the links shown initially.
- Documentation search defaults "},{"id":"p8s11","text":"to Context7 for a named software product or documentation library, and Exa otherwise.
- `web_extract"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"` reads through one enabled service: Tavily, Firecrawl, Parallel, DeepSeek Fetch, smart direct readi"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"ng, or direct reading. It reports the reading route, evidence level, and page details; failure does "},{"id":"p8s14","text":"not switch services.
- Source pagination becomes available automatically after a successful search r"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"etains readable sources. Website mapping is available to the research Agent, not the main Agent; no "},{"id":"p8s16","text":"manual tool loader is needed.
- Supplemental search defaults to no Providers selected. Unselected Pr"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"oviders are never requested; missing credentials and failures of selected Providers remain visible a"},{"id":"p8s18","text":" never requested; missing credentials and failures of selected Providers remain visible as warnings."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"For implementation details, see Search workflow architecture."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 1. Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Supports DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`. DSH dependencies are pinned to this exact release; upgrade the DSH CLI fi"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"rst if you are running an older version."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Install the published npm bundle into the DSH `web` profile:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Research requires a configured, working official DeepSeek service or DeepSeek account. Other connect"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ions fail explicitly without switching services. DSH must be runnable locally for research to start."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### 2. Start DSH Web"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### 3. Configure search"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Open:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"In the settings card:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"1. Set the xAI endpoint or an explicit Grok-compatible gateway and its key under **Credentials → Gro"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"k search**.
2. Choose the matching `completions` or `responses` protocol and model under **Grok sear"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ch backend**.
3. Use the **Supplemental search providers** and **Available extraction providers** dr"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"opdowns to select multiple services. Each service's endpoint, timeout, and credential reference are "},{"id":"p22s5","text":"grouped in its credential card."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Save configuration, then restart DSH to apply it. Saving does not restart the running plugin. A succ"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"essful run shows a `Search` tool row, an answer, and source links."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Example requests"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Use normal language; the plugin gives the Agent routing guidance."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- “Find the most important React 19 user-visible changes. Prefer official release notes and include "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"source links.”
- “Look up the current FastAPI JWT authentication API and show a minimal example from"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" the official documentation.”
- “Read and summarize `https://example.com/article`, separating what t"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"he page states from your inference.”
- “Research these three competing solutions, corroborate the im"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"portant claims, and return source excerpts and unresolved limitations.”"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Ask explicitly when you need more sources or pages from a specific website. Check the plugin setting"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"s for service configuration status."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Providers"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Configure only the routes you need."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Provider | Used for | Default credential reference | Required? |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| Grok-compatible Search API | Main `web_search` answer and sources | `SEARCH_API_KEY` | For `web_se"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"arch` |
| Context7 | Documentation lookup for an explicit library | `CONTEXT7_API_KEY` | No |
| Exa "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"| Broad documentation and supplementary discovery | `EXA_API_KEY` | No |
| Tavily | Supplementary se"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"arch, page extraction, and site mapping | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | No |
| Firecrawl | Supplementary search"},{"id":"p31s5","text":" and page extraction | `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` | No |
| Parallel | Supplementary search and Markdown pag"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"e extraction | `PARALLEL_API_KEY` | No |
| DeepSeek | Supplementary search and Markdown page extract"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"ion; API Key only | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | No |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Select any combination of **supplemental search services** in the plugin settings. Selected services"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" run alongside the main search. Each collects up to `5` sources by default, adjustable to `100`; uns"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"elected services are not requested."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Select **available extraction services** to limit which ones the assistant may use.
